architecture: Dueling 256-256 joint-action Q-network with Double-DQN target estimation
observation_representation: 76-dim Representation B: 38 normalized raw observation features + 38 engineered features derived only from the documented observation
action_space: Full joint 1331-action space using base-11 encoding; run_policy returns quantities in {0,10,...,100}
training_reward: Official base reward plus ShapedReward during training; leaderboard/local reported metrics are computed from the unshaped environment cost
